items.title: L3 Landforms of Glacial Deposition - AQA GCSE Geography Revision
items.description: Dedicated AQA GCSE revision video on erratics, drumlins, and all moraine types with clear diagrams and definitions.

items.title: CASE STUDY AQA GCSE Geog - Lake District Landforms
items.description: Condensed case-study video applying glacial erosion and deposition landforms directly to the Lake District for AQA exam preparation.

items.title: Glaciation of the Lake District - Episode 4
items.description: Focuses on the depositional history of the Lake District, including drumlins and moraines left by retreating ice sheets.

items.title: Drumlins - Glacial Landforms
items.description: Visual explainer using ice-flow animation to show how drumlins form and what basket-of-eggs topography looks like in the field.

items.title: The Lakes with Paul Rose (2018)
items.description: BBC documentary series exploring the Lake District's glacially shaped valleys, tarns, and upland terrain with on-location commentary.

items.title: Planet Earth II (2016)
items.description: The Mountains episode documents high-altitude landscapes including features produced by glacial deposition across Britain and beyond.

items.title: Wainwright Walks (2007)
items.description: BBC series walking Wainwright's routes across the Lake District, passing through valleys and ridges formed by glacial deposition.

items.title: The Lake District: A Wild Year (2016)
items.description: Cinematic documentary showcasing the drumlin fields, moraines, and ribbon lakes of the Lake District across all four seasons.

items.title: Life of a Mountain: A Year on Scafell Pike (2014)
items.description: Filmed on England's highest peak, highlighting the glacially deposited boulder fields and erratics that litter the fells.

items.title: Glacial Landforms in the Lake District - Internet Geography
items.description: AQA-focused page on Lake District drumlins, moraines, and erratics with annotated photos and location examples such as Swindale and Langdale.

items.title: Lake District Landscape - Coolgeography
items.description: GCSE revision page on glacial depositional landforms in the Lake District including moraines, U-shaped valleys, and ribbon lakes.

items.title: Glacial Processes - Seneca Learning AQA GCSE
items.description: Free interactive revision notes covering glacial transportation and deposition, with practice questions on drumlins, moraines, and erratics.

items.title: Revise GCSE Geography (Seneca Learning, Spotify)
items.description: Podcast series with dedicated episodes on glacial deposition landforms including moraines, drumlins, and erratics for AQA GCSE.
